title: Data License Agreement

parties.licensor: DefinedCrowd Corporation (Defined.ai), Seattle WA, asserting ownership of all Data
parties.licensee: all clients covered by this license (the buyer)

permitted_use.value: Internal business use only, for the Licensee's own benefit; commercialising the Data itself (free or paid) is excluded; anything not expressly authorised is prohibited.

ai_training_rights.value: Training, testing and benchmarking models is allowed and the resulting models may be commercialised, only while the Data itself is not made available and the model does not output recognisable Contributor content (e.g. recognisable TTS voices, avatars); no redistribution of the Data; fine-tuning is not named separately.

field_of_use.value: Data is described as assets for training/testing speech, NLP, computer vision and other models; usage capped at Exhibit A limits, extra use needs written agreement and extra fees.

territory.value: No territorial limit on the grant; US export-control compliance and approvals required before making the Data available outside the US.

term_duration.value: Runs from the Effective Date until terminated; either side (including Defined.ai) may end it on 60 days' notice without cause, or at once for uncured breach (30 days); not perpetual.

sublicensing.value: Non-sublicensable and non-transferable; no disclosure, sale, sublicence, publication or other making available to third parties without Defined.ai's written authorisation; no assignment without consent.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: Trained models may be commercialised but must not output recognisable Contributor content; the published text bars copying or modifying the Data and publishing any compilation or directory derived from it.

attribution.value: No credit requirement; Licensee must not remove proprietary notices included in the Data.

audit_rights.value: Defined.ai may audit the Licensee's records at its own expense on reasonable notice; Licensee keeps records during the Term plus two years.

deletion_on_termination.value: On termination the buyer must stop using and delete, destroy or return all copies and certify deletion in writing (clause cross-refers to 'Section 7b', a drafting slip for 8b); no refund.

warranties_by_provider.value: None: Data is provided as is; Defined.ai disclaims all warranties including title, non-infringement, accuracy and completeness.

indemnity.value: Defined.ai indemnifies the buyer against third-party claims that Permitted Use infringes US IP or data-protection rights (conditional on notice and Defined.ai controlling defence; excludes combination with non-Defined.ai data and breach of use restrictions; sole IP remedy); buyer indemnifies Defined.ai for negligence, wilful misconduct and unauthorised use. Defined.ai's side is subject to the overall fees-paid cap.

liability_cap.value: Defined.ai's aggregate liability capped at total amounts paid to it, limited to proven direct damages, notwithstanding any other provision; consequential damages excluded for Defined.ai only; no cap on the buyer.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: Buyer pays fees to Defined.ai; usage beyond Exhibit A limits carries extra fees set by Defined.ai; delivery may be suspended after 15 days' unpaid undisputed amounts; no refund on termination. No revenue share or contributor payment terms in this document.

takedown_and_erasure.value: No data-subject erasure pass-through; on an infringement or data-protection claim Defined.ai may modify/replace the material, obtain rights, or terminate for the affected part immediately, after which the buyer must delete its copies; parties cooperate on data-protection obligations.

governing_law.value: Washington State law; exclusive jurisdiction of federal or state courts in Seattle / King County.

change_of_terms.value: No unilateral change: amendments only in writing signed by both parties.

prohibited_uses.value: No resale, sublicensing or redistribution; no reverse engineering or deriving compilation methods; no removing notices; no derived compilations/directories; no unlawful use under privacy law; no infringing use; no recognisable Contributor output from models.

unknowns.note: No warranty that contributors or people depicted consented or signed releases; all warranties are disclaimed, and the only protection is the licensor indemnity for third-party data-protection claims.
The DLA does not distinguish Defined.ai-collected from partner-supplied datasets; Defined.ai asserts ownership of all Data and there is no pass-through of provider terms.
Silent on whether models trained before termination may continue to be used or sold once the Data must be deleted.
The published Exhibit A gives only a generic description and security clause; the per-dataset usage limits the grant refers to are not published.
No price or fee amounts in the DLA; fees are referenced but set elsewhere.

notes: Published text has drafting defects: placeholder '[database/data feed]' unfilled, two sections numbered 4 and none numbered 5, undefined term 'Data Assets', garbled restriction '(i) copy, modify, or, in whole or in part', and the deletion clause cross-refers to 'Section 7b'.
